snip.t: CT/MR angiography: Is there aortic coarctation or aneurysm? — Narrowing of aortic arch, delayed femoral pulses
Tachypnea​ (>60 breaths per minute in the neonate; >40 breaths per minute in the older infant), Blood\npressure (Do 4 limb blood pressures if aortic coarctation is suspected), Oxygen saturation
It suggests aortic coarctation or another cause of impaired flow between the upper and lower body; assess blood pressure in both arms and legs where appropriate.
